name: Four Seasons Hotel Mexico, D.F.
positioning: Hacienda-style luxury hotel on Paseo de la Reforma, beside Chapultepec Park

facts.text: Located at Paseo de la Reforma 500 in Colonia Juárez, Mexico City, on a historic avenue near Chapultepec Park, the Zona Rosa and the Historic Centre.
Opened in March 1994 with 240 rooms and suites on 8 stories: 200 guest rooms and 40 suites.
Hacienda-style architecture built around a quiet garden courtyard with fruit trees, tropical plants and Mexican folk art; updated in a 2015 renovation.
Guest rooms are described as 538 square feet, with French doors opening onto private terraces or balconies.
Zanaya serves Mexican Pacific cuisine (ceviches, aguachiles, wood-fired dishes) and hosts a Sunday brunch with live music.
Other dining: Il Becco (Italian), OMA (Japanese omakase, 8 seats), Pan Dulce bakery and the Fifty Mils cocktail lounge with Mexican street food.
Benito Juárez International Airport is approximately 30-40 minutes away by car.
The hotel is pet-friendly: pets under 30 pounds are allowed, and size restrictions may apply.

highlights.text: The central courtyard garden, with fruit trees, tropical plants and Mexican folk art, is the heart of the hacienda-style building.
Zanaya, the Mexican Pacific restaurant, is known for ceviches, aguachiles and a Sunday brunch with live music.
Bosque de Chapultepec, one of the world's great urban parks, is steps away, with Condesa, Roma and Polanco described as within walking distance.
OMA is an intimate Japanese omakase counter with just 8 seats.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
The spa is small: 2 treatment rooms plus in-room services, and there is one pool with a sun deck. WhataHotel notes the urban location lacks resort-style amenities.
The airport is approximately 30-40 minutes away by car.
The hotel is in Colonia Juárez on Paseo de la Reforma, in the city rather than a resort setting.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily (the standard published rate is room only, with breakfast usually extra).
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers are combinable with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access (the standard published rate charges extra for internet access).
